input.summary: Add frequency, notice, cost and no-system-access limits to IBM's investigation right.
input.comment: [Playbook] Investigations of our use must be limited: once per 12 months, 30 days' notice, business hours, at IBM's cost and without access to our systems.

ops.text: Any investigation under this Section 11.3 will be conducted no more than once in any twelve (12) month period, upon at least thirty (30) days' prior written notice (except where IBM reasonably believes an emergency exists), during normal business hours, at IBM's expense unless the investigation reveals an underpayment by Customer exceeding five percent (5%), and without direct or remote access by IBM to Customer's systems or premises.

input.summary: Add a 90-day conformance warranty with repair/replace/refund remedy and carve the express warranties out of the "AS IS" disclaimer.
input.comment: [Playbook] "Reasonable care and skill" with an "AS IS" disclaimer on Materials leaves us no remedy; we have added a 90-day conformance warranty with re-performance, repair or refund and excluded the express warranties from the disclaimer.

ops.text: c. for a period of ninety (90) days following delivery, the Materials and each deliverable will conform in all material respects to the applicable documentation and Service Option Attachment; Customer's remedy for breach of this warranty is, at IBM's option, re-performance, repair or replacement, or a refund of the charges paid for the non-conforming Services or Materials.

ops.oldText: c. IBM PROVIDES ALL MATERIALS AND ALL NON-IBM SERVICES
ops.newText: c. Except for the express warranties in Section 5.1, IBM PROVIDES ALL NON-IBM SERVICES

input.summary: Insert a Vendor insurance clause in Article 14.
input.comment: [Playbook] IBM hosts our environment and data, so standard insurance (CGL, E&O and cyber) with certificates on request is required; we can drop to E&O USD 1M and cyber USD 2M if needed.

ops.text: 14.12A Insurance. IBM shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term and for one (1) year thereafter: commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; and, where IBM processes Content or Customer data, cyber liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000. IBM shall provide certificates of insurance on request.

input.summary: Insert transition assistance and data-return obligations in Section 3.5.
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 3.5 addresses only our payment obligations. We need up to six months' transition assistance, return of our data in a machine-readable format within 30 days and certified deletion thereafter.

ops.text: Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement or any Service Option Attachment for any reason, IBM will (a) at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at IBM's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days, return all Content and Customer data in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete Content and Customer data from its systems and certify such deletion in writing.
